card.name: Survey methodology and error discussion
card.fires_on: Small words and commas inside passages about how surveys and polls are run, especially sampling, margin of error and nonsampling error. It fires on the linking word or punctuation, not on the word survey itself.

modes.label: Error wording in survey notes
modes.description: Commas and linking words inside lists or phrases about survey error and margin of error.
modes.example: It has an overall margin of error<< of>> plus or minus 2 percentage points.

modes.label: Poll design and conduct
modes.description: Linking words in statements about how polls or surveys are carried out or affected by sampling.
modes.example: The sampling procedures are specific to each country and may<< affect>> what mode is selected for data collection.

card.writes: It suppresses the next word being a survey term, a prediction that survey or poll is the next word.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in survey-method text, such as notes on margin of error and sampling.
